hook: Two circles, a crossing, and an endless sheet of paper.
outcome: Explore Euclidean construction using a compass, an unmarked straightedge, and made points.
sources: Euclid, The Thirteen Books of the Elements, T. L. Heath translation (Cambridge, 1908), Books I, IV, XIII. Public domain in the US. https://archive.org/details/thirteenbookseu00heibgoog . Enunciations and postulates supplied in spec.md; original diagrams.

Tangency half-separation tolerance 1e-7 times radius; crossing merge 1e-7 times largest stroke, at least one sheet unit; free and given merge 1e-9 sheet units.
